changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW bawiarenka_visits_llm WITH (security_invoker = on) AS WITH internal_browsers (browser_id) AS ( VALUES ('9a1e9795-570e-47c6-90b8-957193f71bd1'::uuid), ('c12a81c0-d2e4-41a6-9f69-7f6232ad46ca'::uuid), ('d52e8573-43e3-4620-a2cb-a84951448cec'::uuid) ), page_sections (section, position) AS ( VALUES ('start', 1), ('przyjecia', 2), ('oferta', 3), ('galeria', 4), ('urodziny', 5), ('kontakt', 6), ('faq', 7) ), base_sessions AS ( SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.browser_id AS visitor_id, s.event_datetime AS started_at, s.metadata->'utm'->>'utm_source' AS utm_source, s.metadata->'utm'->>'utm_medium' AS utm_medium, COALESCE(s.metadata->'utm'->>'utm_campaign', '') AS utm_campaign, COALESCE(s.metadata->'utm'->>'utm_term', '') AS utm_term, COALESCE(s.metadata->'ads'->>'gclid', s.metadata->'ads'->>'gbraid', s.metadata->'ads'->>'wbraid') IS NOT NULL AS has_google_click_id, s.metadata->'ads'->>'gclid' = 'test123' AS has_test_gclid, s.metadata->'ads'->>'fbclid' IS NOT NULL AS has_fbclid, COALESCE(s.metadata->'current_session'->>'path', '') AS landing_path, COALESCE(s.metadata->'current_session'->>'url', '') AS landing_url, COALESCE(s.metadata->'current_session'->>'referrer', '') AS referrer, COALESCE(lower(substring(s.metadata->'current_session'->>'referrer' FROM '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*://([^/:?#]+)')), '') AS referrer_host, CASE WHEN (s.metadata->'device'->>'is_phone')::boolean THEN 'phone' WHEN (s.metadata->'device'->>'is_tablet')::boolean THEN 'tablet' ELSE 'desktop' END AS device, concat_ws(' ', s.metadata->'browser'->>'os', s.metadata->'browser'->>'browser') AS os_and_user_agent, COALESCE(s.metadata->'location'->'address'->>'city', s.metadata->'locationUserInfo'->>'city', '') AS city FROM sessions AS s WHERE s.domain = 'bawiarenka.com' ), session_events AS ( SELECT e.session_id, e.event_datetime, e.metadata->>'id' AS element, e.metadata->>'type' AS type, GREATEST(0, round(extract(epoch FROM e.event_datetime - bs.started_at)))::int AS second FROM events AS e JOIN base_sessions AS bs ON bs.session_id = e.session_id WHERE e.domain = 'bawiarenka.com' ), event_timeline AS ( SELECT session_id, string_agg('+' || second || 's ' || element || ':' || type, ' | ' ORDER BY event_datetime) AS journey FROM ( SELECT se.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, element = 'consent' ORDER BY event_datetime) AS consent_number, lag(element || ':' || type) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_datetime) AS previous_event, lag(event_datetime) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_datetime) AS previous_event_datetime FROM session_events AS se ) AS t WHERE (element IS DISTINCT FROM 'consent' OR consent_number = 1) AND (previous_event IS DISTINCT FROM element || ':' || type OR event_datetime - previous_event_datetime >= interval '2 seconds') GROUP BY session_id ), faq_opens AS ( SELECT se.session_id, bs.visitor_id, replace(se.element, 'faq-', '') AS question, min(se.event_datetime) AS first_opened_at FROM session_events AS se JOIN base_sessions AS bs ON bs.session_id = se.session_id WHERE se.type = 'open' AND se.element LIKE 'faq-%' GROUP BY se.session_id, bs.visitor_id, se.element ), visit_faq AS ( SELECT session_id, string_agg(question, ', ' ORDER BY first_opened_at) AS faq_opened FROM faq_opens GROUP BY session_id ), event_stats AS ( SELECT session_id, max(event_datetime) AS last_event_at, bool_or(type = 'click' AND element IN ('hero-reserve', 'occasions-reserve', 'bar-reserve')) AS clicked_reserve, bool_or(type = 'focus' AND element IN ('email', 'message')) AS focused_form, bool_or(element = 'birthday-form' AND type = 'invalid') AS form_invalid, bool_or(element = 'birthday-form' AND type = 'failed') AS form_failed, bool_or(element = 'birthday-form' AND type = 'sent') AS converted, bool_or(type = 'click' AND element LIKE '%-call') AS phone_clicked, bool_or(type = 'copy') AS phone_copied, bool_or(type = 'click' AND element IN ('contact-instagram', 'contact-facebook')) AS social_clicked, bool_or(type = 'click' AND element IN ('contact-map', 'contact-map-show')) AS map_clicked, count(*) FILTER (WHERE type = 'click') AS clicks_count, min(second) FILTER (WHERE type = 'click') AS seconds_to_first_click, min(second) FILTER (WHERE element = 'birthday-form' AND type = 'sent') AS seconds_to_conversion, min(event_datetime) FILTER (WHERE element = 'birthday-form' AND type = 'sent') AS converted_at FROM session_events GROUP BY session_id ), last_tracking AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.session_id) t.session_id, t.event_datetime, t.metadata FROM tracking AS t WHERE t.domain = 'bawiarenka.com' ORDER BY t.session_id, t.event_datetime DESC ), section_times AS ( SELECT lt.session_id, ps.section, ps.position, (lt.metadata->>ps.section)::numeric AS ms FROM last_tracking AS lt CROSS JOIN page_sections AS ps WHERE (lt.metadata->>ps.section)::numeric > 0 ), section_stats AS ( SELECT session_id, string_agg(section || ' ' || trim_scale(round(ms / 1000, 1)) || 's', ', ' ORDER BY position) AS sections, (array_agg(section ORDER BY position DESC))[1] AS furthest_section, max(position) AS furthest_position, (array_agg(section ORDER BY ms DESC, position))[1] AS top_section FROM section_times GROUP BY session_id ), visit_stats AS ( SELECT bs.*, bs.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Warsaw' AS started_at_local, row_number() OVER visitor_visits AS visit_number, round(extract(epoch FROM bs.started_at - lag(bs.started_at) OVER visitor_visits) / 60)::int AS minutes_since_previous_visit, CASE WHEN bs.has_google_click_id OR bs.utm_medium = 'cpc' THEN 'google_ads' WHEN bs.utm_source = 'google' AND bs.utm_medium = 'organic' THEN 'google_business_profile' WHEN bs.referrer_host ~ '(^|\.)google\.' AND bs.referrer_host <> 'tagassistant.google.com' THEN 'google_organic' WHEN bs.referrer_host ~ '(^|\.)instagram\.com$' OR bs.utm_source IN ('instagram', 'ig') THEN 'instagram' WHEN bs.referrer_host ~ v.seconds_to_first_click, v.seconds_to_conversion, v.visit_after_conversion, v.is_internal, v.is_test, v.journey, concat_ws(', ', format('Visit %s of %s (day %s)', v.visit_number, v.total_visits, AS summary, v.total_visits AS visitor_total_visits, date_trunc('second', v.first_visit_local) AS visitor_first_visit, date_trunc('second', v.last_visit_local) AS visitor_last_visit, vis.days_active AS visitor_days_active, vis.first_source AS visitor_first_source, vis.devices AS visitor_devices, vis.converted AS visitor_converted, vis.visits_before_conversion AS visitor_visits_before_conversion, vis.days_to_conversion AS visitor_days_to_conversion, vis.total_duration_s AS visitor_total_duration_s, COALESCE(vf.faq_opened_all, '') AS visitor_faq_opened_all, vis.max_furthest_section AS visitor_max_furthest_section FROM visits AS v JOIN visitor_stats AS vis ON vis.visitor_id = v.visitor_id LEFT JOIN visitor_faq AS vf ON vf.visitor_id = v.visitor_id ORDER BY visitor_last_visit DESC, v.visitor_id, v.visit_number;
